observations.text: Words are entered once. Event details starts directly on When & Where; a summary keeps the title and opening visible without duplicate inputs.
Artwork generation ran while schedule, guest notes, RSVP and registry were completed.
The only initial venue field is labelled Venue name. A parent testing an online event has no visible Online choice and must guess whether to paste a URL.
End date (if different) is always visible even for a simple one-hour birthday; collapsing it behind an overnight/multiple-day option would shorten the form.
Two guest-text disclosures have near-overlapping purposes: Message to guests and Anything else guests should know. A short example would clarify when to use each.
Playwright fill returned success for date/time but values were absent after tab navigation; native setValue persisted date and both times. This does not establish a product defect.

UI says Your card is ready and Publish invitation appears enabled, but clicking Publish is blocked by a style_mismatch in isolated lettering. The checker says every approved word is correct/readable/unclipped. This mismatch in readiness messaging makes it unclear what the parent must do next.
Lettering findings expose internal asset/composition jargon and a long diagnosis. A parent-friendly summary with one repair action and optional technical details would preserve capability.
Optional wording corrections appear with Apply wording suggestion and Keep my wording but no visible proposed correction in the inspected UI. Kept exact approved wording to avoid an unclear revision.
Download event/path retrieval hung for 314 seconds and reset CUA. Later UI confirms Download started. The actual local file path is unknown; this is not evidence that the product download failed.
